$comment: S4 Y2 gate (b) — hand-verified fixture corpus. Written and independently cross-checked BEFORE any Office extractor exists in this repo (see MANIFEST.md for how, and for the exact definition of every field). A future extractor's test suite loads this file and asserts EXACT MATCH per fixture, per field. A parse error on any fixture whose `valid` is true is a FAILURE, never a skip. `valid: false` fixtures MUST fail to parse (or MUST be reported as a coverage `error` row with zero units, per the wave brief's F8 coverage-honesty rule) — any partial output from one is a failure of the extractor, not a pass.

counting_rules.body_top_level_paragraphs: Count of <w:p> elements that are DIRECT CHILDREN of <w:body> in word/document.xml — i.e. paragraphs in the document's main reading flow, NOT paragraphs nested inside a table cell (<w:tc>). Verify: unzip the fixture, open word/document.xml, count top-level <w:p> siblings under <w:body> (a table's own <w:tbl> element is one sibling regardless of how many cells/paragraphs it contains).
counting_rules.heading_paragraphs: The subset of body_top_level_paragraphs whose <w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="..."/> names a heading style (Heading1, Heading2, ...). Listed with style id and exact text.
counting_rules.list_paragraphs: The subset of body_top_level_paragraphs carrying a <w:numPr> (numbering properties) — i.e. a list item — listed with its numId and ilvl (indent/nesting level; 0 = outermost).
counting_rules.tables: Count of <w:tbl> elements anywhere in word/document.xml (this corpus only ever places them at the top level of <w:body>, never nested). Each table's shape is given as rows x the column count of its first row (this corpus uses only rectangular tables).
counting_rules.table_cell_paragraphs: Total <w:p> elements nested inside ANY <w:tc> across all tables in the fixture — i.e. every table cell's own paragraph. Distinct from and NOT included in body_top_level_paragraphs.
counting_rules.footnote_references_in_body: Count of <w:footnoteReference> elements inside word/document.xml's body flow — i.e. how many footnote markers the reading text actually contains.
counting_rules.footnote_content_entries: Count of <w:footnote> elements in word/footnotes.xml EXCLUDING the two structural placeholders every Word-produced footnotes part carries (w:type="separator" and w:type="continuationSeparator", id -1 and 0) — i.e. only footnotes carrying actual author content, matched 1:1 against footnote_references_in_body by design in this fixture.
counting_rules.header_parts: Count of distinct word/headerN.xml parts present in the package and referenced from word/_rels/document.xml.rels.
counting_rules.footer_parts: Count of distinct word/footerN.xml parts present in the package and referenced from word/_rels/document.xml.rels.

fixtures.covers: deliberately malformed — an unclosed <w:p> element inside an otherwise well-formed zip/OOXML package
fixtures.expected_behavior: word/document.xml is not well-formed XML (mismatched tag). A conformant extractor MUST fail this fixture outright — a coverage `error` row with zero units (F8) — and MUST NOT yield any paragraph, heading, or partial output. Any non-empty output, or a silent empty-success result, is a gate (b) FAILURE for this fixture, not a pass and not a skip.
fixtures.verified_parse_error: Python xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring on word/document.xml raises xml.etree.ElementTree.ParseError: mismatched tag: line 6, column 4 (independently reproducible — see MANIFEST.md).
